programs.title: Generative AI (GenAI) Engineer
programs.tagline: Build practical AI applications using large language models, retrieval systems and agent workflows.
programs.headline: Don't Just Use AI. Learn to Engineer It.
programs.prerequisites: No prior AI experience required. Python is introduced in the longer tracks.
outcomes: Explain GenAI, LLMs, tokens, context windows and common use cases.
Design effective prompts and structured outputs.
Integrate model APIs and build AI-enabled application features.

Document Q&A assistant using semantic search and basic RAG
AI customer support assistant with function calling and API integration
Advanced Capstone: Multi-agent research or operational assistant with memory, tools and web UI
